verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const a="app/(main)/admin/actions.ts",p="app/join/[slug]/page.tsx";if(!fs.existsSync(a)||!fs.existsSync(p))process.exit(79);const A=fs.readFileSync(a,"utf8"),P=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");const manual=/update\(\s*\{\s*member_count:\s*\([^)]*member_count[^)]*\)\s*\+\s*1/.test(A);const anyRow=/alreadyMember\s*=\s*!!membership/.test(P);if(manual){console.error("SCAN-744: joinViaInviteLink still adds one to circles.member_count by hand on top of the trg_memberships_member_count trigger, so every invite-link join counts twice and the circle reports full while seats are free.");process.exit(1)}if(anyRow){console.error("SCAN-744: the invite page still treats any membership row, pending or inactive included, as already joined.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: joinViaInviteLink drops the manual member_count bump (the trigger counts), reactivates pending or inactive rows, maps the circle_full raise, bumps used_count conditionally; the invite page treats only an active row as joined.
